U.S. coat of arms / Great Seal eagle: US Government, public domain. Monochrome vector by Ssolbergj. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Greater_coat_of_arms_of_the_United_States_(monochrome).svg
China national emblem: monochrome by Sangjinhwa, public domain official insignia. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:National_Emblem_of_the_People%27s_Republic_of_China_(black_and_white).svg
Both rendered as white ink with transparent negative space for the atlas.
